title: orbitopt GNC relative-measurement sensor task configuration (E13-03)
description: One task-configuration document declaring every relative-navigation sensor of a closed-loop GNC run: what it measures (channels), how it errs (white noise, constant bias, declared latency, random and burst data loss), and from where the numbers come (every error parameter carries a source string -- a citation, or 'DESIGN ASSUMPTION: ...'). Timing here is the INPUT to the E13-01 clock: sensor_config_to_sensor_spec() feeds ClockSpec, so the clock stays the single authority over ticks and drops. Parsed by orbitopt.gnc.sensors.sensor_task_config_from_document.

channel.description: Measurement channels orbitopt.gnc.sensors implements (the registry CHANNELS; extending the vocabulary means adding a registry entry AND this enum value).

sigma.description: 1-sigma additive white noise, in the channel's declared unit. Zero is refused: a zero-variance claim is a filter trap, not a perfect sensor.

bias.description: Constant (time-invariant) bias added to every measurement, channel unit. A bias is deterministic scenario data, not a random draw -- the same every tick of the run.

source.description: Where the numbers come from: a reference, a qualification record, or 'DESIGN ASSUMPTION: <rationale>'.

random_drop_p.description: Independent per-tick drop probability outside bursts.

burst_enter_p.description: Per clear tick, probability of starting a burst of consecutive dropped frames.

burst_mean_ticks.description: Mean burst length in ticks (geometric run length, support >= 1). Ignored when burst_enter_p is 0.

dropped_ticks.description: Explicit scenario-declared dropped ticks (merged with the stochastic schedule).

kind.description: Sensor profile (SENSOR_KINDS in orbitopt.gnc.sensors): which channel subsets are legal and how measurements map to the Cartesian Observation.

phase_s.description: First-sample phase within one period -> SensorSpec.phase_s.

latency_s.description: Declared measurement delay (the 'delay' error is modelled as the E13-01 clock declares it: t_available = t_sample + latency, constant per sensor, so replay stays checkable).

bias_covariance_mode.description: 'none': declared covariance covers white noise only -- the filter must model biases (bias states) or its NIS will inflate, which E13-03's consistency tests demonstrate. 'bounded': the declared variance conservatively includes bias^2 (bias sign unknown).

seed.description: Reproducibility root: noise draws are keyed (seed, tick), the dropout mask by (seed, n_ticks) -- pure functions, same config same data.

source.description: Provenance for timing + profile + bias mode.
